name: Volbeat

name: Servine
flavour_text: Servine’s one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

name: Serperior

1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Team Rocket's Magmar

flavour_text: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon’s body.

flavour_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

flavour_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Fennekin
flavour_text: Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

name: Braixen
flavour_text: Braixen’s branch ignites as it’s pulled from the Pokémon’s tail. Braixen then uses the flame to spark powerful attacks.

name: Delphox

1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Team Rocket's Lapras

1.name: Ruthless Whirlpool
1.effect: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

2.name: Hailstorm
2.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Wingull
flavour_text: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Pelipper
flavour_text: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavour_text: Its ecology is starkly different from that of other Basculin, so theories that it’s a totally different species have gained traction in recent years.

name: Hisuian Basculegion

1.effect: This attack does 50 more damage for each point your opponent got during their last turn.

flavour_text: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.

name: Team Rocket's Voltorb
flavour_text: It’s usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Team Rocket's Electrode

flavour_text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.

2.name: Thunderclaw
2.effect: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it.

name: Blitzle

1.name: Double Headbutt

flavour_text: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.

name: Zebstrika
flavour_text: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.

name: Team Rocket's Pincurchin

1.name: Poison Jab
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

name: Team Rocket's Slowpoke

1.name: Scavenge
1.effect: Put a random Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

ability.name: Evil Inspiration

1.name: Hand Kinesis
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your hand.

name: Team Rocket's Drowzee
flavour_text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Team Rocket's Hypno

1.effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Team Rocket's Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Team Rocket's Mewtwo

1.name: Psychic Explosion
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Espurr
flavour_text: Behind an Espurr’s expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavour_text: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.

name: Oranguru

1.name: Punch and Draw
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Marowak

1.name: Punish
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has “Team Rocket” in its name, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Landorus

1.name: Gaia Impact
1.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Team Rocket's Ekans
flavour_text: A very common sight in grasslands and such. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

name: Team Rocket's Arbok

1.name: Shadow Seeker
1.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets its prey, it won’t give up the chase, no matter how far the prey goes.

name: Team Rocket's Grimer

1.name: Sludge
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

name: Team Rocket's Muk

1.name: Poison Absorption
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Team Rocket's Koffing

1.name: Reverse Thrust
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That’s why it’s always slightly airborne.

1.name: Confusion Gas
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Team Rocket's Sneasel

1.effect: Flip a coin for each Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Togedemaru

1.name: Tumbling Attack
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Cufant

name: Copperajah
flavour_text: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkatink
flavour_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkatuff
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Team Rocket's Tinkaton

1.name: Pile-Driving Hammer

name: Gholdengo

name: Gible

1.name: Take Down
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Gabite

1.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Duraludon
flavour_text: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

name: Team Rocket's Meowth

name: Team Rocket's Persian

1.name: Dangerous Rogue
1.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
